method.sourceOnset: First independent 1024-sample 48 kHz RMS block at or above .002.
method.firstComment: Media clock when first in-viewport animation frame sees unique visible DOM comment.
method.formalRecording: 6 frozen files x 5 starts. Recording begins before source onset, normal stop after observing the first comment and at least onset+550ms. All saved. p95 is nearest rank.
method.frameRate: Three full Wave file playthroughs per version. Runtime complete-second count cross-checked against same-page rAF/GL draws. No forced captures or speed/quality overrides.
